_about: Actuated-coordinated controller settings for Corridor R-1, Milestone 1. Timing constants (yellow, all-red, minimum greens, walk, pedestrian clearance, LPI, cycle lengths) come from networks/corridor_r1/spec.json (DZ 3.4). Every value in this file is an M1 modeling choice and must be reviewed before results are reported.

phase_assignment.4: SB through and right (plus permissive SB left at I2)
phase_assignment.8: NB through and right (plus permissive NB left at I2)

sequence_note: Leading mainline lefts (1 before 2, 5 before 6) and leading side lefts (3 before 4, 7 before 8). At 6-phase intersections phases 3 and 7 do not exist.

coordination.cycle_reference: cycle time 0 is the programmed start of the main group (barrier into phases 1, 2, 5, 6)
coordination.yield_point: programmed end of coordinated green (fixed in the cycle)
coordination.coordinated_rest: coordinated phases rest in green when no other phase can be served
coordination.offset_method: eastbound progression at the posted speed, aligned on the programmed start of phase 2

actuation.detection: the stop-bar detectors defined under detection in spec.json (loops at I1 and I2, radar zones at I3, video zones at I4); each feeds the phase its lane serves
actuation.call_memory: non-locking for vehicles; pedestrian calls latch until a walk is served

split_method: Webster-style allocation of effective green in proportion to critical flow ratios from expected movement flows (S2 uses the 17:00-17:45 core), subject to minimum green and pedestrian minimums; rounded to whole seconds
